observations: gh-aw tries to cancel a rate-limited run, but pre_activation has only actions: read, so the cancel fails with HTTP 403. The skip still holds because activated is false; the run is reported as success with skipped jobs, not as cancelled, so it does not show as a failure in the Actions list.
Issues about 1 minute apart did not exhaust the API quota of the daily-credit scan (Q3 failure mode not reproduced at this spacing).
